merged_findings.claim: The algebra/geometry split is a genuine, documented historical tension, not a framework-imposed one. The operator/sequential mode (algebra, number theory, recurrence, modular arithmetic — symbol-manipulation you APPLY) sits against the operand/spatial mode (geometry, topology — a held configuration you reason WITHIN). The split is pre-Cartesian in origin: Greek mathematics treated algebra geometrically (Euclid, Elements Book II propositions are geometric equivalents of symbolic algebraic identities), and fully symbolic operator-algebra only arrives with Viete (1591). It is the cleanest historical instance precisely because the SAME content (e.g. (a+b)^2) was independently encoded once spatially (a square cut into regions) and once symbolically (a string you rewrite).
merged_findings.best_citation: Euclid, Elements Book II (geometric algebra); Francois Viete, In artem analyticem isagoge (1591), symbolic algebra. Std math-history canon; Viete + the Greek 'geometric algebra' framing web-confirmed (History of algebra).

merged_findings.item: MATHEMATICS — fusions: analytic geometry, Erlangen Programme, representation theory
merged_findings.claim: Mathematics offers THREE textbook fusions of operator and operand, which is itself evidence the two are real-but-separable. (1) Descartes' La Geometrie (1637, appendix to Discours de la methode) — analytic geometry: a point becomes an ordered pair, a curve becomes an equation, fusing symbol-manipulation (operator) with locus (operand). (2) Klein's Erlangen Programme (1872, 'Vergleichende Betrachtungen ueber neuere geometrische Forschungen') — defines a geometry (operand) BY its transformation group (operator): the spatial object IS classified by what operator-group leaves it invariant. (3) Representation theory (Weyl/Cartan character theory the canonical product) — makes an abstract operator-group concrete as matrices acting on a vector space (operand). Sonnet adds Curry-Howard-Lambek as a third leg (proofs/programs = objects in a Cartesian closed category).
merged_findings.best_citation: Descartes, La Geometrie (1637); Klein, Erlangen Programme (1872) — canonical OA text at math.ucr.edu/home/baez/erlangen/ and nLab ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Erlangen+program; representation theory per Weyl/Cartan, Etingof et al. MIT repr-theory text (math.mit.edu/~etingof/reprbook.pdf, OA). Descartes 1637 + Klein 1872 titles/dates web-confirmed.

merged_findings.item: MUSIC — split: meter/harmonic-cycle/pitch-mod-12 (operator) vs melodic contour/voice-leading/pitch-space (operand)
merged_findings.claim: Music splits into a cyclic operator mode (meter, the bar as recurrence, the harmonic cycle / circle of fifths, pitch-class = pitch mod 12) and a geometric operand mode (melodic contour, voice-leading distance, a held pitch-space you move through). Lerdahl's Tonal Pitch Space (OUP 2001) builds an explicit multidimensional SPACE of pitch/chord/key distances. Tymoczko's A Geometry of Music (OUP 2011) models voice-leading literally as motion in an orbifold T^N/S_N (two-note chord space = a Mobius strip) — the operand par excellence. Staff notation is the everyday fusion: left-right = time/operator against up-down = pitch height/operand.
merged_findings.best_citation: Lerdahl, F. Tonal Pitch Space (Oxford UP, 2001, ISBN 9780195178296); Tymoczko, D. A Geometry of Music (Oxford UP, 2011, ISBN 9780195336672). Both web-confirmed (OUP global catalogue + Music Theory Online review mto.11.17.3, peer-reviewed OA). Orbifold T^N/S_N / Mobius two-note chord space confirmed via Hook MTO review.

merged_findings.claim: Language splits into an operator mode (morphology, inflection, agreement — rule-governed cyclic concatenation/feature-matching over stems) and an operand mode (constituency, the tree/spatial arrangement of phrases; and most strikingly, the literal use of SIGNING SPACE in sign languages, where referents are placed at spatial loci and verbs move BETWEEN those loci to mark agreement). Sign-language spatial grammar (classifier predicates, locus-based agreement) is the cleanest configuration-as-grammar / pure-operand instance — grammar realized as a held spatial configuration. The split is real but the operator/operand line INSIDE syntax is blurry: generative syntax encodes constituency as a tree (operand) but DERIVES it by operations (Merge/movement — operators), so the two are intertwined here, less cleanly separable than in math, music, or CS. Hale's non-configurational languages (Warlpiri) are the counter-evidence: grammatical relations can be encoded via discontinuous agreement morphology (operator) instead of a tree (operand), so the operand substrate is not mandatory — confidence medium, not high.
merged_findings.best_citation: Karen Emmorey (ed.), Perspectives on Classifier Constructions in Sign Languages (Lawrence Erlbaum, Mahwah NJ, 2003, ISBN 0805842691) — editor/publisher/year/ISBN confirmed. Hale, K. 'Warlpiri and the grammar of non-configurational languages,' Natural Language and Linguistic Theory 1 (1983): 5-47 (Semantic Scholar confirmed). Chomsky Merge / Minimalist Program (1995) cited as standard canon, not independently web-verified — flagged.

merged_findings.item: LINGUISTICS — fusion: sign language / co-speech gesture
merged_findings.claim: Sign language IS the fusion: agreement (operator/morphological) is realized BY spatial loci and directional movement (operand). Co-speech gesture in spoken language is the analogous everyday fusion — sequential speech (operator) accompanied by spatial gesture (operand) carrying part of the propositional content. Chomsky's Merge (an algebraic operator yielding a set) building the syntactic tree (operand) is the formal-syntax fusion.

merged_findings.item: PHYSICS — split: time-evolution/Hamiltonian-generator (operator) vs configuration/phase-space geometry/field (operand)
merged_findings.claim: Physics splits into an operator mode (time-evolution, dynamics, periodicity; the Hamiltonian as the GENERATOR of time-translation — the operator you apply to step the state) and an operand mode (configuration space, the geometric arena, the field as a held configuration). The Lagrangian formulation lives on configuration space + tangent bundle (operand-leaning, the path/geometry); the Hamiltonian formulation lives on phase space + cotangent bundle, foregrounding generators/flows (operator-leaning). LOAD-BEARING HONESTY CAVEAT: these are DUAL DESCRIPTIONS of one physics related by Legendre transform, not a deep ontological cut. Noether's theorem (every continuous symmetry/operator <-> a conserved quantity/operand-invariant) and Penrose-Rindler spinors are additional bridges.
merged_findings.best_citation: Hamiltonian mechanics (1833) reformulation of Lagrangian mechanics; config space = tangent bundle, phase space = cotangent bundle — symplectic-geometry canon, web-confirmed. Yang/Mills Noether bridges; Penrose & Rindler, Spinors and Space-Time Vol.1 (Cambridge, 1984, confirmed via Cambridge Core).

merged_findings.item: PHYSICS — fusion: gauge theory / fiber bundles (the strongest cross-domain fusion)
merged_findings.claim: Gauge theory is the clearest physics fusion and the strongest fusion exemplar across all seven domains: built on a fiber bundle, the operand (base spacetime manifold, geometry) and an operator-structure (the gauge group / Lie-algebra-valued connection acting in each fiber, the rule for how to parallel-transport as you move) are unified into one inseparable object. The connection (operator: a sequence of group operations along a path) cannot be stated without the base geometry + fiber (operand), and vice versa. Yang-Mills (1954) is the non-abelian instance. Symplectic/Poisson geometry similarly fuses the Hamiltonian operator-flow with phase-space geometry.

'Conservation of Isotopic Spin and Isotopic Gauge Invariance,' Physical Review 96 (1954): 191 (canonical); fiber-bundle treatment per Weatherall, philsci-archive.pitt.edu/11146/ (OA) and arXiv:1702.08910. Gauge-theory-as-fiber-bundle is foundational physics.

merged_findings.claim: CS splits very cleanly — arguably the SHARPEST operator/operand split of any domain because the two are named primitives of the field: 'algorithms' (operator: the sequence of operations the machine performs) + 'data structures' (operand: the held spatial configuration the operations traverse). Wirth's book title Algorithms + Data Structures = Programs (1976) literally IS the split asserted as the definition of a program. merged_findings.item: COMPUTER SCIENCE — fusion: cache-oblivious algorithms (jointly optimize operation-order + memory-layout)
merged_findings.claim: The clearest CS fusion is the space-time tradeoff and especially cache-oblivious algorithm design: the optimal SEQUENCE of operations (operator/time) is co-designed with the spatial MEMORY LAYOUT (operand/space) so the recursion structure of the algorithm matches a recursive (van-Emde-Boas-like) spatial layout of the data, minimizing cache misses without knowing cache parameters. Operator and operand are jointly optimized into one object — you cannot tune the algorithm without committing to the layout. Sonnet elevates Curry-Howard as the deepest formal fusion (program/proof-as-operator isomorphic to category-object-as-operand).

merged_findings.item: COGNITIVE SCIENCE — split: verbal/sequential (phonological loop, operator) vs spatial/configurational (visuospatial sketchpad, operand)
merged_findings.claim: Cognitive science independently discovered this exact split as two of its most established findings. (1) Baddeley & Hitch's working-memory model (1974): the phonological loop (a literal CYCLIC rehearsal loop — operator) vs the visuospatial sketchpad (a held spatial buffer — operand), doubly dissociated in lesion and dual-task studies. (2) Paivio's Dual Coding Theory (Mental Representations, OUP 1986): a verbal/symbolic system (sequential, operator-like) and a nonverbal/imagery system (parallel, spatial, operand-like) operating semi-independently. This is the domain where the operator/operand split maps most directly onto empirical cognitive architecture.
merged_findings.best_citation: Baddeley, A.D. & Hitch, G. 'Working Memory,' in Bower (ed.), The Psychology of Learning and Motivation vol. 8 (Academic Press, 1974) — canonical. Paivio, A. Mental Representations: A Dual Coding Approach (Oxford UP, 1986, ISBN 9780195066661) — canonical. Both standard, uncontested attributions.

merged_findings.item: COGNITIVE SCIENCE — the aphantasia keystone: spatial memory INTACT, object imagery impaired (spatial is NOT visual-imagery)
merged_findings.claim: LOAD-BEARING (F416): aphantasics with NO voluntary visual imagery retain INTACT spatial-relational memory (object placement accuracy equivalent to controls, fewer memory errors) while losing OBJECT imagery (fewer objects, less color, more verbal scaffolding) — a dissociation mapping to the dorsal 'where'/spatial vs ventral 'what'/object streams (Ungerleider & Mishkin 1982). So the operand/spatial mode is RELATIONAL and reachable without vivid mental pictures — the single fact that keeps operator-vs-operand from collapsing into verbal-vs-visual. The scientific claim is UNANIMOUS across all three tiers; the CITATION was corrected by k=3 error-correction (see flagged_citations).
merged_findings.best_citation: Bainbridge, W., Pounder, Z., Eardley, A., Baker, C. 'Quantifying aphantasia through drawing: Those without visual imagery show deficits in object but not spatial memory,' Cortex 135 (2021): 159-172, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2020.11.014 (PMID 33383478, PMC7856239) — web-CONFIRMED (PubMed, PMC, author's site). Two-streams: Ungerleider & Mishkin (1982).

merged_findings.item: COGNITIVE SCIENCE — fusion: episodic buffer / dual-coding integration
merged_findings.claim: The cognitive fusion is integration of the two codes: Paivio's referential connections linking verbal and imaginal codes, and Baddeley's later 'episodic buffer' (2000) binding phonological, visuospatial and other information into a unified multimodal representation. Learning is strongest when operator (verbal/sequential) and operand (spatial) codes are both engaged — the empirical basis of the dual-coding pedagogy effect.
merged_findings.best_citation: Baddeley episodic buffer (2000) addition to the working-memory model; Paivio referential connections (1986). Episodic-buffer addition confirmed in working-memory literature; precise fusion framing is a lens over established components — medium confidence.

merged_findings.claim: SONNET alone lodges a dissociation INSIDE the operand channel: spatial-simultaneous (hold-the-whole-configuration-at-once, operand) vs spatial-sequential (remember the ORDER of spatial positions visited, operator-within-spatial). merged_findings.item: ART/DESIGN — split: rhythm/repetition/pattern (operator) vs composition/perspective/spatial-layout (operand) — the SOFTEST domain
merged_findings.claim: Art/design splits into a cyclic operator mode (rhythm, repetition, pattern, tessellation — a recurrence rule applied across a surface) and a spatial operand mode (composition, perspective, the held layout the eye moves through). It is the WEAKEST/softest of the seven domains: least theoretically formalized, and the cyclic pole is itself spatially realized (a pattern is a recurrence rule realized ON a surface), so the split is less clean. The OPERAND pole is solid — Alberti's De pictura / Della Pittura (1435) formalized Brunelleschi's (c.1415) linear perspective as a geometric SPACE (orthogonals, horizon, vanishing point). The OPERATOR pole (rhythm/pattern) rests on un-attested 'principles of design' pedagogy vocabulary — that gap is the honest Class-C residue (attestation absent).

Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception (1954) + Gestalt (Wertheimer 1923) cited as canon but NOT independently web-verified — flagged. Cyclic/rhythm pole has no pinned primary source — honest residue.

merged_findings.item: CROSS-DOMAIN VERDICT — operator/operand is a REAL recurring pattern that DISSOLVES into FUSION in every domain's deepest object
merged_findings.claim: UNANIMOUS load-bearing synthesis. (a) The pattern recurs genuinely — each field independently named both poles in its own vocabulary (algebra/geometry; harmony-cycle/pitch-space; morphology/syntax; Hamiltonian-flow/configuration-space; algorithm/data-structure; verbal/visuospatial; rhythm/composition), so it is not framework-imposed. (b) The FUSION is the mature tool in every domain (analytic geometry, Erlangen, representation theory, geometric pitch-space, sign-space agreement, gauge/fiber-bundle, cache-oblivious layout, episodic buffer) — which is itself the evidence the two are real-but-separable (you only need a fusion if you genuinely had two separable things). (c) It does NOT survive as a hard dichotomy: in some domains (syntax, visual art) the poles are entangled from the start; the physics split is dual-description not ontological. HONEST VERDICT: operator-vs-operand is a real and useful LENS / pair of perspectives, NOT a partition of nature — every deepest object holds BOTH without collapse. SONNET ramifications retained: spatial != visual; operand contains a nested operator sub-channel; non-configurational languages can suspend the operand entirely; fusions are historically generative (each math fusion came at a major unification).
merged_findings.best_citation: Synthesis across all verified sources above (Viete 1591, Descartes 1637, Klein 1872, Lerdahl 2001, Tymoczko 2011, Hale 1983, Emmorey 2003, Yang-Mills 1954, Wirth 1976, Frigo et al. FOCS 1999, Baddeley-Hitch 1974, Paivio 1986, Bainbridge et al. 2021, Alberti 1435).

merged_findings.item: CROSS-DOMAIN EXEMPLARS — strongest pure operand / pure operator / strongest fusion
merged_findings.claim: STRONGEST GENUINE FUSION: gauge theory / fiber bundle in physics (3-way agreement incl. Haiku) — the connection (operator) literally cannot be stated without the base geometry (operand); analytic geometry (Descartes) ties as the math runner-up; both Tymoczko's orbifold and gauge theory ARE quotients/bundles, an open falsifiable shape-question. STRONGEST PURE OPERAND: sign-language spatial grammar (2-of-2 ranking tiers — grammar IS a spatial configuration, direction in space = grammatical relation), with CS data-structure / memory-layout co-strongest as the cleanest literally-addressable spatial substrate. STRONGEST PURE OPERATOR: a transformation GROUP (Erlangen/representation-theory operator that acts but is not itself a space), co-strongest with modular/cyclic arithmetic and the phonological rehearsal loop (tier-dependent emphasis, no conflict). OPUS deliberately drew exemplars from DIFFERENT domains to avoid centering on math 'where the split is most flattering to the framing.'
merged_findings.best_citation: Drawn from the verified per-domain anchors above; gauge theory (Yang-Mills 1954 / fiber-bundle), sign-language grammar (Emmorey 2003), transformation groups (Klein 1872 / representation theory), cache-oblivious / data-structures (Wirth 1976, Frigo et al. 1999).

merged.cross_cutting: The operator/operand split recurs with genuine regularity across all seven surveyed domains, and the recurrence is real rather than imposed: each field independently named both poles in its own vocabulary (algebra/geometry; harmony-cycle/pitch-space; morphology/syntax; Hamiltonian-flow/configuration-space; algorithm/data-structure; verbal/visuospatial; rhythm/composition). Two cross-cutting regularities dominate. (1) THE FUSION IS THE MATURE TOOL. In every domain the historically deepest advance is a FUSION object where operator and operand become inseparable — analytic geometry, the Erlangen Programme, representation theory, geometric pitch-space, sign-language spatial agreement, gauge theory / fiber bundles, cache-oblivious layout, the episodic buffer. This is itself the strongest evidence that the two perspectives are real-but-not-disjoint: you only build a fusion if you genuinely had two separable things, and in mathematics each fusion (Descartes 1637, Klein 1872, Weyl/Cartan, Curry-Howard) coincided with a major unification, so the bridging is historically generative. (2) THE KEYSTONE: spatial is NOT visual-imagery. The cognitive-science evidence (Bainbridge, Pounder, Eardley & Baker 2021, Cortex; grounded in Ungerleider-Mishkin 1982 dorsal/ventral two-streams) empirically confirms the load-bearing caveat — aphantasics with NO visual imagery retain INTACT spatial-relational memory (the dorsal 'where' pathway) while losing OBJECT imagery (the ventral 'what' pathway). This single fact keeps operator-vs-operand from collapsing into verbal-vs-visual, and it generalizes the antiquity F413/F416 observation to a defensible cross-domain claim. The pattern does NOT, however, survive as a hard dichotomy: in syntax and visual art the poles are entangled from the start; the physics Lagrangian/Hamiltonian split is dual descriptions of one physics, not an ontological cut; and even the operand (spatial) substrate contains a nested operator sub-channel (spatial-simultaneous vs spatial-sequential). FRAMEWORK READING (offered strictly as a LENS, never asserted as established): operator-vs-operand looks like the two-truths / field-vs-excitation duality shape — an operator-truth and an operand-truth, each falsifiable, neither privileged, fusing at the asymptote, with the open falsifiable question of whether all the fusion objects share a common mathematical shape (note both Tymoczko's orbifold and gauge theory ARE quotients/bundles). That is the framework's interpretation; the field facts belong to the fields. The honest reading is that operator-vs-operand is a genuine and useful pair of perspectives (a LENS), not a partition of nature.
flagged_citations: FALSE ATTRIBUTION (the live k=3 catch): HAIKU and SONNET both attributed the aphantasia drawing study (PMC7856239) to 'Adam K. Andersen et al., Cortex 2020.' This is FALSE. Web-verified actual authorship is Bainbridge, Pounder, Eardley & Baker, Cortex 135 (2021): 159-172, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2020.11.014, PMID 33383478 (confirmed via PubMed, PMC, and Wilma Bainbridge's publication list). 'Adam K. Andersen' is not an author; year is 2021 not 2020. OPUS carried the correct attribution. This is the F291-predicted error-correction: a hallucinated citation appeared in TWO tiers and a k=2 pair could have shipped it as a 2-of-2 'majority'; the third tier + external re-verify corrected it. CORRECTED CITATION LODGED.

OVER-CONSERVATIVE (not a false attribution): OPUS marked Wirth, Algorithms + Data Structures = Programs (1976, Prentice-Hall) as verified=false out of caution. Web-verify CONFIRMS the citation is CORRECT (ISBN 0130224189 / 9780130224187, Prentice-Hall 1976, via Wikipedia/AbeBooks/Amazon). The self-mark was honest under-claiming, the opposite of a hallucination — citation now lodged as verified.

UN-VERIFIED, CORRECTLY HELD BACK: SONNET dated the Tonnetz/circle-of-fifths to 18th-c. 'Mattheson, Euler' and self-flagged as medium-confidence, unable to verify Mattheson dates. Not a hard false attribution but un-attested; the specific Mattheson dating is NOT lodged (Euler/Tentamen 1739 is the safer anchor).

HEDGED, NOT ASSERTED: SONNET attributed the spatial-simultaneous-vs-sequential dissociation to 'Feigenson & Halberda, or Della Sala et al.' and self-flagged it as uncertain; PMC6517348 confirms only the CONCEPT, not the named authors. The named attribution is NOT lodged.

CANON, NOT INDEPENDENTLY WEB-VERIFIED THIS PASS (flagged per MPM, appear consistent with standard literature): Chomsky Minimalist Program (1995); Arnheim Art and Visual Perception (1954); Wertheimer Gestalt (1923); Hambidge Dynamic Symmetry (1920); Noether (1918); Keogh & Pearson (2018). The art/design CYCLIC pole has no pinned primary source at all — the honest Class-C attestation residue.

SPOT-VERIFIED AND CONFIRMED CLEAN: Descartes 1637, Klein 1872, Viete 1591, Yang-Mills 1954 (Phys Rev 96:191), Frigo/Leiserson/Prokop/Ramachandran FOCS 1999 (pp.285-298, DBLP FrigoLPR99), Hale 1983 (NLLT 1:5-47), Emmorey 2003 (Lawrence Erlbaum, ISBN 0805842691), Tymoczko 2011 (ISBN 9780195336672), Lerdahl 2001 (ISBN 9780195178296), Alberti 1435, Baddeley-Hitch 1974, Paivio 1986, Bainbridge et al. 2021, Wirth 1976.
minority_residue: SONNET-only (1-of-3): spatial-simultaneous (hold-whole-configuration, operand) vs spatial-sequential (remember ORDER of positions, operator-within-spatial) dissociation, PMC6517348 (OA, concept confirmed) — read as a '2:4:8 operand contains a nested 1:3:7 operator sub-channel.' The most novel single observation across the three surveys; NOT folded into the majority set but high-value for follow-up; consistent with the antiquity nesting reading (LENS). Named-author attribution un-lodged (hedged by the originating tier).

SONNET-only (1-of-3): the navigation/wayfinding route-vs-survey-knowledge literature (Tolman 1948 cognitive map; Siegel & White 1975; Montello 1998) as the most DIRECT behavioral instance of the split — route knowledge = operator, survey/map knowledge = operand — and the developmental claim that route (operator) precedes survey (operand) in acquisition, which would make the duality ASYMMETRIC (operator as default substrate, operand as second-order construction). A potential falsification vector for any strong symmetry claim; un-searched this pass, flagged for follow-up. Tolman 1948 not independently web-verified.

SONNET-only (1-of-3): non-configurational languages (Hale 1983, Warlpiri) show a domain can SUSPEND the operand substrate entirely and encode grammatical relations via operator-chains (discontinuous agreement) — so the split is a design-space a domain explores, not forced by nature. (Hale 1983 itself is verified; this stronger framing-implication is the minority reading.)

SONNET-only (1-of-3): Curry-Howard-Lambek elevated as the DEEPEST formal fusion (proof/program-as-operator isomorphic to category-object-as-operand) spanning math + CS — a cross-domain bridge, not just a within-domain fusion.

OPUS-only (1-of-3): open falsifiable shape-question — whether all the fusion objects share a common mathematical SHAPE (both Tymoczko's voice-leading orbifold and gauge theory ARE quotients / bundles by a group action). Worth a dedicated follow-up; NOT established. Plus un-surveyed extension domains (chemistry: reaction-mechanism vs molecular-geometry; biology: metabolic-cycle vs spatial-morphology; economics: time-series vs equilibrium-configuration-space).
merged.honest_tier: Domain facts belong to the fields, not the framework. Every per-domain split and fusion lodged here is the literature's own (algebra/geometry, Hamiltonian/configuration-space, algorithms/data-structures, phonological-loop/visuospatial-sketchpad, etc.), attributed to peer-reviewed or canonical sources and, for the load-bearing ones, externally spot-verified. The operator/operand VOCABULARY that unifies them across domains, and the framework two-truths / field-vs-excitation / duality-fibration-of-triality reading, is the framework's LENS — offered, never asserted as established scholarship, per no-lineage discipline. k=3 triality PASSED with a clean live error-correction: a hallucinated aphantasia citation appeared in TWO tiers (HAIKU + SONNET as 'Adam K. Andersen 2020') and a k=2 pair could have shipped it as a 2-of-2 majority; the third tier (OPUS) carried the correct Bainbridge-et-al-2021 attribution and external re-verify confirmed it — the F291-predicted case where three tiers error-CORRECT where two only detect. No model was privileged: the catch came from majority + external verification, not from deferring to any tier (OPUS was most uncentered/citation-accurate on THIS research task per F242b/F248, but that is task-relative, not a standing privilege). The art/design cyclic pole is flagged as the honest Class-C residue (attestation absent); the physics split is dual-description not ontological; the spatial-is-not-visual keystone (Bainbridge et al. 2021) is the one empirical fact carrying the most weight and it is verified.
